harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves a persistent local APT repository at http://10.100.45.10:8080. Package local-repo-demo 1.0 was installed from it while the normal Ubuntu repositories were unreachable. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remain unchanged, and all functionality survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Built local-repo-demo_1.0_all.deb and generated APT Packages, Packages.gz, and Release metadata under /srv/local-apt.
Enabled local-apt-repository.service to serve the repository persistently over HTTP.
Configured APT to access the local repository directly while ordinary HTTP repositories use an unreachable proxy.
Installed and executed local-repo-demo 1.0 using fresh local-only indexes.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed, system health recovered, the repository resumed, and the installed package persisted.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Shows the package and repository metadata with matching SHA-256, plus the enabled HTTP service, port 8080 listener, and successful repository response through node1's managed IP.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: Shows Ubuntu archive/security connections refused while fresh local indexes succeed, followed by APT fetching local-repo-demo from node1, installing it, and successfully running its executable.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both initial and post-restart evidence show Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.

Captures the healthy pre-restart boot ID and repository/package state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, running system with zero failed units, recovered repository and matching artifact, persisted installed package, and post-restart APT provenance while remote repositories remain unreachable.
